self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: for 10s after the equipping character triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction, their CRIT Rate is increased by 16% and their Stellar Swirl reaction DMG by 40%. ONLY THE CRIT RATE HALF IS MODELLED: Stellar Swirl is not implemented in the evaluator (no reaction kind, no stellarswirl_dmg_ key), and it must NOT be folded into stellarconduct_dmg_ OR the stellarglimmer_dmg_ umbrella — the kit text says Stellar Swirl specifically, so it is narrower than both. A Stellar Swirl rotation is therefore undercounted by this set's second half.
